source: Existing local Cargo registry source; no extra source download or app build
facts: XDG-portal backend AsyncMessageDialog uses linux::zenity::question for custom Yes/No/Cancel
Zenity command is external executable named zenity resolved on PATH
Spawn error maps to MessageDialogResult::Cancel; app bevestig_formaat maps it to annuleren
FileChooser uses the separate XDG portal, so successful OpenFile/SaveFile does not establish MessageDialog availability
